resources.string: Open the same video on both devices, then join the same server and room. Play, pause and seeking are synchronized. Joining uses normal speed; leaving restores your previous speed.
These are the same video — synchronize
Check the server, port, username and room. Enter a hostname, not a URL.
Controlled rooms are not supported. Choose a regular room.
Open a seekable video before joining.
Not in a room. Joining is always manual.
Synchronization is paused while the player loads
Different video or duration in the room. Synchronization is paused.
The server does not support TLS. Disable TLS only for a server you intend to use without encryption.
TLS certificate verification or negotiation failed.
The server rejected the connection. Check the room and server password.
Disconnected. Playback is local again; join manually to reconnect.
Left the room to keep your manually selected speed.
